chunks: Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
He was asked about a man who said to his wife, "If I marry over you or spend a night away from you, then you are divorced." So he said:
"Indeed, the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: 'Whoever stipulates a condition contrary to the Book of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, that is not valid against him nor for him.'"
He said: And he was asked about a man who said, "Every woman whom I marry, so long as my mother lives, is divorced." So he said:
"There is no divorce except after marriage, and no emancipation except after ownership."

key_terms.تَزَوَّجْتُ: I married; used here in a future-conditioned statement about taking another wife
key_terms.شَرَطًا: a condition or stipulation set by a person
key_terms.طَالِقٌ: divorced; the legal formula of divorce mentioned in the statement
key_terms.طَلَاقَ: divorce; the legal dissolution of marriage
key_terms.عِتْقَ: emancipation; the freeing of a slave
key_terms.كِتَابِ اللَّهِ: the Book of Allah; the revealed divine standard against which conditions are judged
key_terms.مِلْكٍ: ownership; the legal possession required before emancipation can occur
key_terms.نِكَاحٍ: marriage contract; the necessary prior basis for divorce to apply

ai.seo_question: Is a conditional divorce valid if a man ties it to a future marriage or personal condition?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses conditional divorce statements and declares invalid any stipulation that conflicts with the Book of Allah عزّ وجلّ. It also establishes the legal principle that divorce can only occur after an actual marriage contract exists, just as emancipation only applies after ownership exists.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4752 - Hammad narrated from Al-Halabi that Abu Abdullah (as)

was asked about a man who said to his wife, "If I marry another woman over you or spend a night away from you, then you are divorced."
Imam (as) replied: "The Messenger of Allah (swt) (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) said: 'Whoever sets a condition outside of the Book of Allah (swt), it is neither binding upon him nor for him.'"
Imam (as) was also asked about a man who said: "Any woman I marry while my mother is alive is divorced."
Imam (as) replied: "There is no divorce except after marriage, and no emancipation except after ownership."
